description: Image-grounded long-screwdriver tabletop insertion smoke using a public visible wide ring socket target. This variant widens the insertion aperture to test whether the current bottleneck is strict radial tolerance versus rollout/subgoal precision.

target.physical_role: movable public wide thin guide socket on the tabletop: 4.8 cm visual base, 3.0 cm outer guide diameter, 2.4 cm inner guide diameter, 5.5 cm guide height, open top and center aperture, with four thin collision walls around the insertion hole

scene_initialization.start_pose_policy: runtime mesh-table-contact projection keeps the fixed near-hand long_screwdriver mesh on the tabletop with 3 mm clearance; xy and yaw do not vary by seed.

seed_variation_policy.description: Same public socket sampler as deep_socket, with only the public socket geometry and radial success tolerance widened; the long_screwdriver start pose remains fixed near the robot hand and is shared by the VLM render, compile scaffold, and rollout.

scene_initialization.target_grounding_policy: The shared VLM scene-ref interface applies: natural task language and public top-down RGB-D evidence provide start_point at the visible socket opening and scene.direction when applicable. The runner derives the executable terminal point from that public direction plus the benchmark inside-socket goal contract.
scene_initialization.tool_grounding_policy: Use task-conditioned P3SAM/VLM long_screwdriver refs: VLM selects the screwdriver tip/shaft contact-point part, then selects the contact point marker and shaft/tip motion-axis marker from public evidence for that selected part.
scene_initialization.trajectory_policy: Reset/start-pose scaffold for SimToolReal initialization only; not a method input, target trajectory, oracle trajectory, or success template.

acceptance.success_policy: screwdriver_insert_tip_path: a seed succeeds when the diagnostic path gate, compiled terminal socket goal, rollout semantic insertion path, measured tip XY radial alignment within the public socket radius, and measured tip inside-socket depth pass. Tracking/policy-goal pass and full terminal endpoint error are diagnostic.

tool_grounding_contract.notes: Evaluator-side audit labels only; not used for method selection, compiler constraints, or task success. Tip radial alignment and inside-socket depth are the required success metrics.

contract_status.notes: Measured tip radial alignment and inside-socket depth are required; terminal endpoint error is diagnostic.
